title: Gourmet Coffee Subscription Brand: Client Case Study | Brick Marketing

facts.fact: The vendor's case study reports a Gourmet Coffee Subscription Brand client with 23 employees.
Brick Marketing reports that its work for the gourmet coffee subscription client produced a 175% increase in organic traffic.
facts.quote: We helped build up a 175% increase in organic traffic which created a 2 times growth in subscriptions.

facts.fact: Brick Marketing reports that the gourmet coffee subscription client's subscriptions grew 2 times.
facts.quote: We helped build up a 175% increase in organic traffic which created a 2 times growth in subscriptions.

facts.fact: Brick Marketing reports a 40% drop in cost per subscriber for the gourmet coffee client.
facts.quote: This resulted in a 40% drop in cost per subscriber and we were able to achieve first-page rankings for 20+ keywords.

facts.fact: Brick Marketing reports first-page rankings for more than 20 keywords for the gourmet coffee client.
facts.quote: we were able to achieve first-page rankings for 20+ keywords.

facts.fact: Brick Marketing reports 4x higher social media engagement and referral sales for the gourmet coffee client.
facts.quote: There was also 4x higher social media engagement and referral sales.

facts.fact: Brick Marketing states it has served over 600 companies as a B2B digital marketing strategist since 2005.
facts.quote: Trusted B2B digital marketing strategists for over 600 companies, since 2005.

facts.fact: GrowthForce's Marketing & Communications Manager states that over two years Brick Marketing helped increase the company's website traffic by 315.43%.
facts.quote: over the last two years, Brick Marketing has helped increase our website traffic by 315.43%.
